# Signal valve A signal valve is a valve that can be controlled through [textlink="signals" link="Networking"].
A signal valve is similar to a manual valve. Gas can flow freely in either direction, and the valve can also be toggled by hand.
A signal valve has 3 [textlink="signal" link="Networking"] inputs: open, close, and toggle state.
Signal valves can be used for various tasks, such as: - Remotely controlling valves in hazardous areas or places inaccessible to the crew - Conveniently operating a valve in a hard-to-reach area - Automating it with other [textlink="signal" link="Networking"] machines and equipment, such as [textlink="air alarms" link="AirAlarms"] and remote signallers
